subject: Day-of logistics: Sam Wu — Zoom access, quiet suite & interpreter handoff
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@gmail.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Day-of logistics: Sam Wu — Zoom access, quiet suite & interpreter handoff

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking time to meet with the team tomorrow. A quick logistics note so the day runs smoothly:

- 1:00 PM PT — Panel (45 min)
- 2:00 PM PT — Break / quiet window for note-taking (15 min)
- 2:20 PM PT — System design follow-up (30 min)

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=dayof (passcode included in calendar invite)
I attached a short agenda and your last resume for the panel.

Accessibility: you mentioned live captioning — we have booked an ASR live caption stream and Tom Alvarez (interpreter) is standing by if you prefer an interpreter instead. Can you confirm which you prefer and if you need any additional breaks or a quieter environment for the live coding portion?

Also: please review and sign the attached candidate consent form if you haven’t already.

If anything changes, reply here and I’ll loop in who’s needed.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sam-wu_resume.pdf, interview_agenda.docx, candidate_consent_form.pdf

From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Day-of logistics: Sam Wu — Zoom access, quiet suite & interpreter handoff

Thanks Priya —

Prefer a human interpreter for the panel portion (ASL). I’ll use live captioning for the system-design pairing unless Tom suggests otherwise.

I do appreciate the 15-minute quiet window after the panel — that helps. No other accommodations needed. I’ll sign the consent form this morning and confirm when done.

Looking forward to meeting everyone.

— Sam

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@interpreterservices.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.inference>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>

Subject: Fwd: Sam Wu — ASL interpreter request + day-of handoff

Tom / team —

FYI: Candidate Sam Wu will need an ASL interpreter for the panel (1:00–1:45 PM PT). Please see the interpreter_instructions.pdf attached for our standard briefing (audio setup, when to mute, interpretation channel naming). Key items:

- Please join Zoom 10 minutes early (12:50 PM PT) to check audio and the interpretation channel.
- We’ll reserve the "Quiet Suite B" breakout room for a 15-minute buffer after the panel at 1:45 PM PT.
- If you need a separate breakout for interpretation prep with Sam beforehand, schedule it at 12:40 PM PT.

Michael — can you confirm which internal panelists will run the intro and who will host the Zoom? Karthik, please hold Quiet Suite reservation and AV test.

Thanks,
Priya
Attachments: interpreter_instructions.pdf

- Intro: Laura Bennett (1:00–1:10 PM) — welcome + company overview
- Technical questions: Michael Grant & Karthik Iyer (1:10–1:45 PM)

Also attaching a short internal interviewer note: bring two focused prompts for systems design (30/15 split), and call out any accessibility clarifications at the start.

— Michael
